senses.gloss: to close the eyes of; to blind.
units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Exodus 23:8">Targ. Y. Ex. XXIII, 8</cite>.
Ib. XXI, 26; a. e.—Y. Ber. II, 4ᵇ עבור קומוי וסַמֵּי עיניה (euphem. for עיניך) pass it (the idol) and blind thy eye (ignore it); Y. Shek. II, 47ᵃ top; Y. M. Kat. III, 83ᶜ bot. ואַסְמֵי (Af.).
R. Hash. 24ᵇ סמי עיניה דדין put its eye out (destroy the form of the figure); a. e.—Trnsf. (cmp. גָּנַז) to declare apocryphal, repudiate, cancel.

<cite ref="Bava Batra 77b:6">B. Bath. 77ᵇ</cite> <he>אֵיסַמְּיָהּ</he> shall I cancel it (the Boraitha)?; <cite ref="Bava Batra 78b">ib. 78ᵇ</cite> (not <he>איסמיא</he>); <cite ref="Yevamot 40a:26">Yeb. 40ᵃ</cite> <he>אֲסַמְּיָיהּ</he>; <cite ref="Bava Kamma 91b">B. Kam. 91ᵇ</cite>; a. e.—
<cite ref="Shabbat 52a:6">Sabb. 52ᵃ</cite> <he>מאי חזית דמְסַמֵּית הא מקמי הא סמי הא קמי הא</he> what reason dost thou see to repudiate this opinion rather than the other? repudiate rather the other.

senses.gloss: to bind, to act as an astringent. Y. Shek. V, 48ᵈ (Bab. ed. to V, 1) הידין … סמי למעיין Ms. M. (v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. p. 43; ed. סמס, ממסמס) which wine is good for the bowels and which binds the bowels.

units: <cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Ecclesiastes 12:2">Targ. Koh. XII, 2</cite>.—Y. Peah VIII, end, 21ᵇ <he>עייניה … יִסְתַּמְּיָין</he> may the eyes of him who saw thee and gave thee nothing, become blind; Y. Shek. V, end, 49ᵇ.
<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 22:4">Lev. R. s. 22</cite> <he>ואִיסְתַּמְיַת</he> and she became blind.
<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 22:4">Ib.</cite> <he>דין דהוה פתיח א׳</he> he who was open-eyed got blind; a. fr.
